title: Reclaim MCP trace slots for ordinarily cancelled calls that rmcp drops without dispatch
outcome: Reclaim MCP trace slots for ordinarily cancelled calls that rmcp drops without dispatch
acceptance: Determine whether 256 ordinary client cancellations of distinct IDs, which permanently disable trace association, happen in real long-lived TermAl sessions, using trace evidence
If they do, propose a safe way to observe rmcp dropping a cancelled response, so its slot can be retired without the cross-generation hazard; otherwise record why the limit is acceptable
